slots.label: Paragraph 1
slots.default: Not covered here? Ask us directly — same working day response.

slots.label: Paragraph 2
slots.default: A plan that connects technology decisions to where the business is actually going. In practice it is a prioritised roadmap with costs and dates, a lifecycle view of your hardware and contracts, and a risk register. The test of a good one is whether it helps you make a decision faster and cheaper than you would have otherwise.

slots.label: Question 2
slots.default: Do we need an IT strategy if we are small?

slots.label: Paragraph 3
slots.default: Smaller teams often benefit most, because there is less slack to absorb a surprise. A lightweight roadmap that tells you the server needs replacing within eighteen months and roughly what that costs is worth far more than a thick document, and it stops the decision arriving as an emergency.

slots.label: Paragraph 4
slots.default: A prioritised roadmap covering the next twelve to twenty four months with indicative costs, an asset and renewal register with dates, and a risk register with owners and next steps. Written to be read by whoever signs off the budget rather than only by someone technical.

slots.label: Question 4
slots.default: How often should it be reviewed?

slots.label: Paragraph 5
slots.default: Quarterly or half-yearly for most businesses. Short reviews keep the plan connected to reality, which an annual exercise never manages. What changed, what got done, what moves up the list. It is usually an hour well spent.

slots.label: Question 5
slots.default: Do you need to audit us first?

slots.label: Paragraph 6
slots.default: It helps a great deal. A roadmap built on assumptions about what is installed, how old it is and what it is licensed for tends to unravel on contact with the facts. If you have never had a proper technology audit or IT health check, that is the sensible first step and it makes everything afterwards more accurate.

slots.label: Question 6
slots.default: Will you just recommend your own services?

slots.label: Paragraph 7
slots.default: The roadmap has to be useful to you or it is worth nothing, so it includes things we do not sell and occasionally the advice to keep something you already have rather than replace it. Where we are the right people for a piece of work we will say so, and you are free to price it elsewhere.
